description: This script processes binary files by creating a header with specified addresses, then prepends this header to the input binary data and writes out a new file. It uses command-line arguments to specify input/output files and addresses.

methods.name: auto_int(x)
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer, determining the numeric base automatically.

methods.name: create_header(args, size)
methods.description: Creates a binary header with entry address, load address, and size packed in big-endian format.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads input file, creates header, and writes header and file data to output file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Parses command line arguments, sets default addresses if not provided, and initiates the file processing.
